recoveryDraft.content:
Build a lightweight personal desktop assistant called "Office Junior" using Electron and Vanilla JavaScript, powered by the Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite API and a native local whisper.cpp process for push-to-talk speech-to-text.


Project Constraints & Architecture:

1. Tech Stack: Electron, Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS (no heavy frontend frameworks), Node.js built-ins (fs, path, child_process, os), and @google/genai.

2. Architecture:

- main.js: Electron window lifecycle, IPC handlers, safe tool execution, and local whisper.cpp child process execution.

- preload.js: Context-isolated bridge exposing safe IPC channels to the renderer.

- renderer/: index.html, styles.css, and app.js for a clean mid-blue semi transparent chat UI with a push-to-talk button, message stream, and settings drawer.

- memory/: A local folder containing USER.md (profile & rules), LONGTERM.md (persistent facts), and MEMORY.md (working memory).

- bin/: Folder holding the compiled whisper.cpp binary and ggml-base.en.bin model file (include a setup script or instructions to fetch/place them).


Key Features to Implement:


1. Speech-to-Text via whisper.cpp:

- In the renderer, implement a push-to-talk mechanism (holding the Spacebar or a dedicated mic button) using the Web Audio API / MediaRecorder to capture mono 16 kHz WAV audio.

- On release, send the audio buffer over IPC to main.js.

- In main.js, write the buffer to a temporary file, run whisper.cpp as a child process against the audio file, capture stdout as the transcribed text, delete the temp file, and return the transcription to the UI.


2. Brain & Context Orchestration:

- Use the Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite model via @google/genai.

- On each chat turn, read memory/USER.md, memory/LONGTERM.md, and memory/MEMORY.md to construct the systemInstruction.

- Handle multi-turn conversation history.


3. Native Tools (Function Calling):

- Scaffold Project: Accepts a folder path, project name, and an array of subdirectories/starter files to create on disk.

- Manage File: Safely read, write, and delete text files within the user's home or project directories.

- Update Memory: Allows the model to autonomously append new working notes or learned facts to memory/MEMORY.md or memory/LONGTERM.md with date stamps.

- Add Calendar Event: Accepts title and date/time parameters and logs the action (or runs an OS calendar trigger).


4. Text-to-Speech (TTS):

- Use the browser engine's built-in Web Speech Synthesis API (window.speechSynthesis) in app.js to automatically speak incoming model replies using the default system voice. Add a toggle in the UI to mute/unmute audio replies.


5. UI & Settings:

- Clean mid-blue semi transparent chat interface with auto-scrolling message list and loading indicators.

- A settings modal/drawer allowing the user to view and edit memory/USER.md directly from the UI and configure their GEMINI_API_KEY.


Please create all required directories and files, initialize package.json, install dependencies, and launch the application using `npm start`.


This is an test.
